references.text: Joseph interprets the seven lean cows as seven years of famine, which is the direct dream interpretation that verse 30 elaborates on.
The fulfillment of Joseph's prediction: the seven years of famine began, and the famine was in all lands.
The famine was very severe and struck all of Egypt and Canaan, a direct fulfillment of the prediction in Gen 41:30.
The psalmist describes how God called famine upon the land and broke every supply of bread – a reference to the famine in Joseph's time.
Jeremiah describes a severe drought and famine over Judah, with parallels to the all-encompassing famine in Gen 41:30.
Jesus mentions the great famine in Elijah's time, an example of God's sovereignty over famine, as also seen in Gen 41:30.
Verse 36 shows God's providence as a response to the prophecy of destruction in verse 30.
Verse 54 documents the actual fulfillment of the prophecy in verse 30.
Verse 23 marks the transition from abundance to famine as predicted in verse 30.
Verse 48 describes the concrete plan to meet the famine warned about in verse 30.
